article.title: Liquid AI的LFM3走小型多模態路線，專項部署需另作評估
article.title_en: Liquid AI’s LFM3 targets specialized work with compact multimodal models
article.summary: Liquid AI於10月27日發布LFM3，首批為約20億參數級別的六款模型，涵蓋文字、視覺、音訊、全模態及決策用途。
article.summary_en: Liquid AI’s October 27 LFM3 release comprises six roughly two-billion-parameter-class models covering text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks.
article.why: 處理大量內容分類、素材檢查或客服分流的團隊，可評估專項小模型的部署取捨，仍需用實際語言與資料測試。
article.why_en: Teams handling content classification, asset checks or service routing can assess specialized small models against their own language and data requirements.
article.next_step: 交技術團隊選一項唯讀分類任務，用已匿名資料比較準確率、延遲、硬件成本與授權條款。
article.next_step_en: Have technical teams compare accuracy, latency, hardware costs and license terms on one read-only classification task using anonymized data.
highlights: 公司提供開放權重、Playground及API路徑，並主張可用自身資料微調與本地部署。
兩款決策模型處理結構化判斷；其輸出方式與撰寫長文的通用聊天模型有所區別。
highlights_en: The company provides open weights, Playground and API access, with local fine-tuning and deployment described.
Two decision models produce structured judgments, a different role from a general chatbot writing long-form responses.
article.detail:
Liquid AI於10月27日發布LFM3，首批為約20億參數級別的六款模型，涵蓋文字、視覺、音訊、全模態及決策用途。

公司提供開放權重、Playground及API路徑，並主張可用自身資料微調與本地部署。

兩款決策模型處理結構化判斷；其輸出方式與撰寫長文的通用聊天模型有所區別。

處理大量內容分類、素材檢查或客服分流的團隊，可評估專項小模型的部署取捨，仍需用實際語言與資料測試。

交技術團隊選一項唯讀分類任務，用已匿名資料比較準確率、延遲、硬件成本與授權條款。

本則保留10月27日原始發布日期；供應商基準及所有裝置皆可運行等概括聲稱不作本刊實測結論，亦不推定粵語品質。
article.detail_en:
Liquid AI’s October 27 LFM3 release comprises six roughly two-billion-parameter-class models covering text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks.

The company provides open weights, Playground and API access, with local fine-tuning and deployment described.

Two decision models produce structured judgments, a different role from a general chatbot writing long-form responses.

Teams handling content classification, asset checks or service routing can assess specialized small models against their own language and data requirements.

Have technical teams compare accuracy, latency, hardware costs and license terms on one read-only classification task using anonymized data.

This item retains the October 27 release date. Vendor benchmarks and broad device claims are not independent tests, and Cantonese quality is not assumed.
